analysis: Reviewed the head-side text of DistributedAutomaticBatchPlannerTests.swift (lines 1-778). The change is test-only: the fixture() helper gains an optional artifact parameter, and tests cover served-speed history, worker-build filtering, quote envelopes and tensor-share retention. No production code, wire protocol, key handling, authorization or attestation paths change in the supplied units. The tests use constructed CPU metadata, temporary homes created with 0o700 and owner-only 0o600 files, and local shell scripts written only under those temp directories. These are test-only and create no new attack surface. Test coverage of build-scoped served-speed calibration (testServedHistoryOfAnotherWorkerBuildDoesNotReachCalibration, lines 422-436) supports a control that keeps records from other worker builds out of the placement plan. Likewise, the link-probe tests (lines 378-391) exercise rejection of foreign, stale, malformed and world-readable (0o644) probe files, which are owner-only checks. I found no relation to the T-041 prefix-cache threat or to TB-011/TB-012. The patch excerpt is truncated and the units end at line 778; the later changed ranges (769-788, 828-841, 929-969, 1083-1097) are only partly visible. The remaining head lines were not supplied, so I cannot assess them. The corresponding production planner changes, if any, are in other units not supplied here.
